text:
Olivia: heads-up — opened a tiny PR that changes the upstream proxy header we set on onprem sidecars (x-rw-auth -> x-rw-auth-v2) and shrinks the secret surface for the token projection. pinging sec for a quick sanity check before I merge in the next slot.
Raj: can you drop the PR link? I want to eyeball the header change. worried about old consumers relying on x-rw-auth for metrics/ingress filters.
Olivia: https://git.company/repo/pull/4827 — it’s a 6-line change. main thing: header rename + remove a fallback that read the old vault path. added a little migration comment.
Leah: quick Q — does the fallback removal affect Dedicated customers that still run older sidecars? we should be explicit in the changelog and possibly add a canary flag.
Olivia: good point. the change is behind the feature flag `enable_auth_v2` by default on prod for hosted; on onprem customers it's opt-in during upgrade. the removal just avoids reading vault path `secret/onprem/legacy/tokens`.
Marta: plus one for a short e2e smoke. can you run the projection flow with `kubectl logs` checks? basically confirm no 401s for projected tokens.
Olivia: will run. plan: deploy to staging onprem cluster, run `kubectl apply -f k8s/onprem/sidecar.yaml`, then exercise auth flow with the smoke script.
Olivia: smoke command:
```bash
./scripts/smoke-projection.sh --cluster=onprem-staging --token-path=secret/onprem/new/tokens
```
Raj: if smoke is green I can do a quick code review. one ask: add a short note in the PR about expected behavior for older sidecars (explicitly that they'll ignore x-rw-auth-v2 and continue working until ops flips flag).
Olivia: added note and a migration plan in the PR body. also added a tiny unit test for header mapping.
sec-bot: automated-scan: no secret leaks detected in modified files. dependency-check: none flagged.
Leah: from privacy/reg side — does removing the old vault read change audit logs? we need to ensure audit trails still show token reads for compliance.
Marta: answer: audit events will still be emitted from the new path; we should add a one-liner to the migration doc about where to find the new audit entries for SOC reviews.
Olivia: added migration doc note and linked the audit dashboard (https://dash.company/audit?query=token_read). also included a scheduled 1-hr merge window tomorrow 03:00 UTC if green.
Raj: I can review after the smoke. ETA 2h.
Leah: LGTM for privacy once audit note is in. :thumbsup:
Marta: if sec wants to sign off, we can merge in the scheduled window and promote canary to 10% first.
Olivia: thanks — will post results here. requesting explicit sec OK for merge: @Leah @Marta @sec-bot :eyes:
sec-bot: policy-check: change touches auth header mapping and vault paths. flagged for manual review by Eng-Security. ticket: SEC-2026.
Leah: acknowledging manual review — I’ll look today and confirm before the 03:00 UTC window.
Olivia: smoke run started now, will report back in ~20m.
Olivia: smoke result: projection flow green, no 401s, logs show new vault reads. attaching short grep of logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z sidecar INFO token projection success path=secret/onprem/new/tokens id=xxxx
```
Raj: reviewing now. quick nit: update the PR description to include the `kubectl` command you used and the stdout snippet.
Olivia: done.
Leah: I reviewed the audit samples, looks consistent. marking privacy OK. 
Marta: sec review — small nit about comment wording but not blocking. SEC ack: you have manual review OK, please coordinate with ops for canary rollout schedule.
Olivia: thanks all. merging in the 03:00 UTC slot and will start a 10% canary for 30m, then ramp to 100% if no regressions. will post canary metrics here.
Raj: thanks — will monitor errors and latency dashboards. :rocket:
